NAYON Browser is developed by MD. AHOSHAN HABIB NAYON. It is a privacy-respecting Android browser built with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose.
Draft — this describes the current Stage 1 build and will be updated as features are added. It is not yet a final legal policy.

NAYON Browser is developed by MD. AHOSHAN HABIB NAYON. Website: https://webtecit.com. NAYON Browser may process browsing data locally to provide browser functionality. If optional cloud synchronization, authentication, search suggestions, payment integrations or other connected services are enabled, relevant data may be processed by the selected providers according to their policies. Sensitive credentials must be protected by the implemented security architecture. Private browsing does not make you completely anonymous online. Review the Privacy Policy and individual permission settings before using optional services.
Only your appearance preferences (mode, color theme and schedule) are stored, locally on this device. They are excluded from Android cloud backup and device transfer.
What this build does not do
This build requests no permissions, has no internet access, contains no analytics, advertising or tracking SDKs, and sends no data to the developer or any third party.
Clearing the app\'s storage in Android settings, or uninstalling the app, removes all stored preferences.

When browsing, history, downloads, passwords or optional connected services are added, this policy will be updated to describe exactly what is collected, where it is stored, how long it is kept and how to delete it.
